description: Source code for the PUSCH power control logic in a 5G NR scheduler, including power adjustment, TPC command computation, and PHR handling.

classes.name: pusch_power_controller
classes.description: Class managing PUSCH power control, including power adjustments, TPC commands, and PHR processing.

methods.name: reconfigure
methods.description: Reconfigures the power control parameters based on UE cell configuration.

methods.name: update_pusch_pw_ctrl_state
methods.description: Updates the power control grid with the latest PUSCH transmission info.

methods.name: handle_phr
methods.description: Handles PHR reports to adjust power control and estimate path loss.

methods.name: adapt_pusch_prbs_to_phr
methods.description: Adjusts the number of PRBs for PUSCH based on PHR to prevent power issues.

methods.name: compute_tpc_command
methods.description: Computes the TPC command for power adjustment based on SINR and path loss.
